title: MAIP enriches high-throughput screening for antimalarial hits
summary: The MAIP malaria-activity predictor was combined with a compound-selection workflow and high-throughput cascade to prioritize public-library compounds. The paper reports eight selected hits with potency and ADME profiles and 12-fold enrichment versus a random set. That enrichment is study-specific; private training-set overlap and chemical novelty remain unresolved.
organization: European Molecular Biology Laboratory, European Bioinformatics Institute; Medicines for Malaria Venture

evidence.tested: Primary article reports selected hits, experimental screening and 12-fold enrichment versus random selection.
evidence.unknown: Underlying partner data are partly private; selection and training overlap and exact compound prior art require review; not clinical evidence.
evidence.ai_role: Predictor enriches candidate pool, with staged workflow and human selection preceding experimental screening.

source_review.scope: publisher primary metadata/abstract; author-hosted primary full paper. Material checked for the specific claims stated in the record.
